searchText: You should try and have conversation with a mentor to help scope your project and give you feedback for your project proposal. If you need help getting in touch with someone, let us know. Hey Josh, I need help in getting in touch with Zahary for the project - Verkle implementation in Nimbus. It would be great if you can put me in touch with Kev. I don't see him in the discord server. hey <@466006586477772831> can i DM you for some questions related to EIP-4844? i see that you have worked on it in the previous cohort for lighthouse! Sure! 🙂 sent a friend request! Is there a consensus client or execution client that runs in python? <@427491045308235776> is indeed here! I can ping him in DM if you cannot reach him i couldn't find any tbh. but i think it may not make sense to write a consensus or execution client in python as multi threading is not easy with the GIL Hi, what is the deadline for the project proposal ? End of week 3 (this week) or week 4 ? <@686695036733227017> <@914307919699406908> GM GM! <@686695036733227017> / <@914307919699406908> mind plz have a quick look on my Proposal ? if its good to go i would do a PR 🙂 really appreciate it : https://github.com/sogolmalek/EIP-x/blob/main/Project%20proposal.md End of week 4 is strongly recommend, there is no 'deadline' in literal sense because the program is pernissionless. Nothing happens if you submit it later, you will just need to be able to keep up with development Thank you 👍 yes please
